claim: Loads nine sample policy decisions in one click.
where: Landing primary action and Demo page
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo/; assert the labelled sample renders nine passing decisions, then Reset demo restores it.

claim: Uses mock DNS answers from the fixture.
sandbox: Fresh /demo/ fixture changes the mock monitor address; the observable matrix changes to three regressions and reset restores nine passes.

claim: The browser sample calculates its matrix locally with no third-party request or data upload.
sandbox: Record every browser request from fresh /demo/ load through a sample run; assert same-origin GET requests only while the populated matrix appears.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: A dedicated browser context visits /demo/, waits for its service worker, switches offline, reloads, and retains the populated sample.

claim: Demo changes never touch real data.
sandbox: Seed a real namespace, edit demo data, then Start for real; assert real data is unchanged and demo:ppr:fixture is removed.

claim: The sample and free core run without an account.
sandbox: Fresh /demo/ runs its full sample and exposes the editable fixture without an account or sign-in step.

claim: The ppr binary runs the bundled sample demo.
sandbox: Run the built public executable with demo; assert it creates a temporary bundled fixture and emits the 9/9 matrix.

claim: The CLI reads fixture file paths instead of remote URLs.
sandbox: Run ppr test with a remote-looking path and assert it reports an unreadable local file rather than fetching it.

claim: The CLI does not start or operate a proxy service.
where: What this tool does not do and Terms
sandbox: Run the public executable with a server command and assert its interface rejects the command.
